title: Howls Moving Castle
synopsis: Howl's Moving Castle is a 2004 Japanese animated fantasy film by Studio Ghibli, directed by Hayao Miyazaki and adapted from Diana Wynne Jones's 1986 novel

title: Spirited Away
synopsis: In Hayao Miyazaki's Oscar-winning anime Spirited Away, 10-year-old Chihiro and her parents stumble upon an abandoned amusement park that serves as a gateway to a mystical world of spirits and gods.
